entrances.name: Main Accessible Entrance to 245/246 McCaul Street
entrances.desc: A level path leads t a covered, powered door. Entrance is located at the rear of the building and faces west towards the parking lot. The entrance is located in a narrow recess in the wall but is clearly visible from the parking lot.

entrances.name: Main Entrance to Exam Centre
entrances.desc: A level path leads to a covered, powered entrance. Entrance faces west and is clearly visible from McCaul Street.

entrances.name: Accessible entrance to the Student Commons
entrances.desc: Powered door approached by level sidewalk. The door faces west and is clearly visible from Huron St.

entrances.name: Main entrance to the Fields Institute
entrances.desc: Powered entrance approached by level path, under a large modern awning. The entrance faces south and is clearly visible from College St.

entrances.name: Main Entrance to Health Sciences Building
entrances.desc: An accessible ramp, located at the west end of the entrance, leads to a powerd door. Entrance faces north and is clearly visible from College Street.

entrances.name: Courtyard accessible entrance to the Bahen Centre
entrances.desc: Powered door approached by level path. The entrance faces south into the Bahen courtyard, and is not visible from the street.

entrances.name: Parking elevator accessible entrance
entrances.desc: Powered door approached by level path. The entrance faces south into the Bahen courtyard, and is not visible from the street. The below-grade parking elevators are just inside this entrance.

entrances.name: Accessible Entrance to Stewart Building
entrances.desc: A level path leads to a manual door. Entrance faces west and visible from College Street when approach from the west. Door is locked and requires a key card to enter. Contact the department to arrange for entry.

entrances.name: Accessible entrance to the Koffler Student Services Centre
entrances.desc: Power door approached by stairs and a ramp. The entrance faces east and is clearly visible from St. George st.

entrances.name: Main entrance to Cumberland house
entrances.desc: Powered door approached by stair or by curving landscape ramp. This entrance faces west and is visible from the street.

entrances.name: West side entrance to the Bahen Centre
entrances.desc: Powered door approached by level path. This entrance faces west into the narrow pedestrian lane that runs from Ursula Franklin St. to the Bahen Centre. It is not visible from the street.

entrances.name: Accessible entrance to the Mining Building
entrances.desc: Powered entrance approached by a ramp. The entrance faces east and is difficult to see because it is built into the side of the stair of the main entrance. The blue accessibility sign is clearly visible.

entrances.name: Accessible entrance to the Pratt and Wallberg Memorial Buildings
entrances.desc: Powered door approached by an extensive white-railed access ramp. The entrance faces east, and the ramp is visible from King's College road. Via a cross-through the Pratt building, this entrance also serves as the accessible entrance for Wallberg.

entrances.name: Accessible entrance to the Fitzgerald Building
entrances.desc: Powered door approachable by straight level path. The entrance faces south and is clearly visible from College Street.

entrances.name: Main Entrance to the Bahen Centre for Information Technology
entrances.desc: Powered door approached by ramp and stair. The entrance faces west and is clearly visible from St. George st.

entrances.name: South Entry to the Pharmacy Building
entrances.desc: Entrance approached from a level pathway and is visible from College Street. Door is operated by a power opener from the inside only. Recommend using the main accessible entry immediately to the east and also visible from College Street.

entrances.name: Main entrance to the CCBR
entrances.desc: Powered glass doors at the top of a long low-slope walkway. (slope of 1:20) Entrance faces south and is clearly visible from College Street

entrances.name: Main entrance to the Pharmacy Building
entrances.desc: Powered door approached by level path. This entrance faces west and is visible from the street.

entrances.name: Main entrance to Mechanical Engineering
entrances.desc: Powered door approached by a long level path. The entrance faces west and is clearly visible, under a large awning, from King's College road.

entrances.name: North accessible entrance to the Bahen Centre.
entrances.desc: Powered door approached by level sidewalk. The entrance faces north and is visible from the street if travelling south down St. George St.

entrances.name: Main entrance to Anthropology (accessible)
entrances.desc: 5 steps up to powered doors, facing Ursula Franklin street. A out-door ramp is located to the left of the stairs. The entrance is clearly visible from the street.

entrances.name: Designated accessible entrance to the Haultain Building
entrances.desc: Powered door approached by a very short, steep and rough curb ramp right at the entrance. It is a steel service door roughly for accessible use. The entrance faces west and is only visible from within the dead-end alley.

entrances.name: Accessible entrance to C. David Naylor Building
entrances.desc: Powered door approached by a sloped path. This entrance faces south, into the service/pedestrian corridor between this building and Pharmacy Building. This entrance can be reached from College Street or from the west via a pathway east of the FitzGerald Building.

entrances.name: Secondary accessible entrance to Mechanical Engineering
entrances.desc: Powered door approachable by level path. This entrance faces north and is visible from the street.

entrances.name: Accessible entrance to Galbraith and Sanford Fleming
entrances.desc: Powered door approached by a low-slope ramp. This entrance serves as the accessible entrance for both Sanford Fleming and Galbraith buildings. It is on the North side of Sanford Fleming and is clearly visible from Galbraith rd.

entrances.name: North entrance to the Rosebrugh Building
entrances.desc: Powered entrance approached by level path. The entrance faces north but is not visible from King's College road. The route to the entrance, down the parking road for the Medical Science, is somewhat sloped.

entrances.name: Main accessible entrance to Borden Building North
entrances.desc: Stairs and an accessible ramp lead to a powered door. Entrance faces west and is visible when approaching from the west on Bancroft Avenue.

entrances.name: Main Entrance to the Koffler Institute
entrances.desc: A shallow ramp leads to a powered, glass door. Entrance faces east and is clearly visible at the end of Bancroft Avenue.

entrances.name: Third Bancroft entrance to Earth Science Centre
entrances.desc: A curved accessible ramp leads to a powered, glass door. The entry to the ramp is under the colonnade and leads around the round, red brick tower.

entrances.name: Huron street accessible entrance to McLennon Physics
entrances.desc: Powered door reachable via concrete patio facing Huron street that extends northward along the building face. The ramp to this platform is at the north end of this platform and is steep and uneven. The entrance is partially visible from the street.

entrances.name: Main entrance to McLennon Physics
entrances.desc: Powered entrance at grade. The entrance is only visible from the street looking through the parkette from St. George street.

entrances.name: West entrance to New College Residence
entrances.desc: Level path leads to a powered, glass door. Entrance faces west and is clearly visible from Spadina Avenue.

entrances.name: Rear courtyard entrance to New College Residence
entrances.desc: Level path leads to a powered, glass door. Entrance faces east onto the rear courtyard and is not visible from the street. Approach along the path leading north between New College Residence and Faculty Club or from the south along Bancroft Avenue.

entrances.name: Second courtyard entrance to Earth Sciences Centre
entrances.desc: A level path leads to a powered, glass door. Entrance opens onto the exterior courtyard and is located under the covered colonnade. The colonnade is visible from Bancroft Avenue.

entrances.name: Accessible entrance for Convocation Hall and Simcoe Hall
entrances.desc: Powered exterior door More powered doors inside Accessible washroom inside to the right Elevator inside to the right leads to upper floors of Simcoe Hall ONLY; Convocation hall has no elevators

entrances.name: Main Accessible Entrance to 88 College Street.
entrances.desc: A steep, accessible ramp leads to a manual door. Entrance faces east and is clearly visible from Elizabeth Street. Buzzer is currently not operational, contact staff for assistance (416-978-4695).

entrances.name: Main accessible entrance to Bancroft Building
entrances.desc: a level path leads to a powered, glass door. Entrance faces northeast onto the exterior courtyard of Earth Sciences Centre. Approach from the pathway leading around the building from Bancroft Avenue.

entrances.name: Secondary St. George St. entrance to Lash Miller
entrances.desc: Powered door approached by stairs and accessible ramp. The entrance faces east and is visible from St. George Street. The curving, accessible ramp at the rear of the building in the exterior courtyard.

entrances.name: Accessible / Main entrance (Queen's Park side.)
entrances.desc: Powered door entrance facing Queens Park West. There is no parking (or vehicle stop area) off queens park or around this entrance. The elevator is to the right inside this entrance.. (110816)

entrances.name: Main Entrance to Medical Sciences Building
entrances.desc: Powered doors under the concrete awning, on the raised concrete patio A sloped walkway from King's College Circle leads up to the concrete patio.

entrances.name: Accessible entrance to Faculty Club
entrances.desc: A powered door is approached along an accessible, wooden ramp in the alley on the east side of the building. Entrance faces east and is not clearly visible from the street.

entrances.name: Main accessible entrance to New College Residence
entrances.desc: A level path leads to a powered, glass door. Entrance faces north and is clearly visible from Willcocks Street.

entrances.name: Main entrance to the Visitors Centre
entrances.desc: Level path leads to a powered door. Entry faces south and is visible when walking north around King's College Circle. There is no access to Knox College from this entrance.

entrances.name: JJR Macleod Auditorium entrance
entrances.desc: Power glass doors, to your left under the concrete awning. Across from the entrance to the MSB. Reachable by ramp from Kings College Circle. Macleod hall has its own washrooms on the main floor.

entrances.name: Northwest entrance to Earth Sciences Centre
entrances.desc: A level path leads to a powered, glass door. Entrance faces north and is recessed into the building making it difficult to see until standing directly in front of it on Willcocks Street.

entrances.name: Rear accessible entrance to Lash Miller
entrances.desc: Ramp and stairs leading to powered door. Entrance is located in the rear of the building next to the metal pillars and outdoor seating at the end of the mid-block courtyard.

entrances.name: South entrance to Wilson Hall
entrances.desc: An accessible ramp leads to a powered door. Entrance faces east and is clearly visible from Willcocks Street. Entrance provides access to classrooms and elevator.

entrances.name: Main entrance to Lash Miller Chemical laboratories
entrances.desc: Powered doors under large awning. Three steps up with a long low-slope ramp to the right. Entrance faces St. George street.

entrances.name: Main entrance to Macdonald Mowat
entrances.desc: Powered door approachable by ramp and stair. The door faces south and is visible from St. George st. if one is approaching from the south.

entrances.name: D.G. Ivey Library entrance to Wilson Hall
entrances.desc: An accessible ramp leads to a powered door. Entrance faces east and is clearly visible from Willcocks Street. Entrance provides access to the D.G. Ivey Library and lower level classrooms.

entrances.name: West courtyard entrance to Wilson Hall
entrances.desc: Ramp and stairs lead down to a powered door. Entrance faces east and opens onto the exterior courtyard. It is not visible from the street but is clearly visible from within the courtyard.

entrances.name: Accessible entrance to Canadiana building
entrances.desc: Powered door at the top of concrete out-door ramp. There is no parking on this side of the building (facing Queen's Park West)

entrances.name: Entrance to Sid's Cafe
entrances.desc: Powered doors at the bottom of a ramp. The ramp can be accessed from the east closer to St. George Street. Entrance faces south to Willcocks Common.

entrances.name: Main entrance to Alumni House
entrances.desc: Powered door approachable by ramp and stair. The entrance faces east and is clearly visible from the circle.

entrances.name: Accessible entrance to Gerstein Science Information Center
entrances.desc: Powered door located at grade to the left of the main entrance. Look for the blue awning. Ring Bell for assistance in opening door.

entrances.name: North entrance to Wetmore Hall - New College
entrances.desc: A level concrete path leads to a powered, wooden door. Entrance faces east and is visible when approaching from the east along Classic Avenue.

entrances.name: South entrance to Warren Stevens Building
entrances.desc: A powered door is approached by a level pathway. Entrance is located under a concrete awning and faces the outdoor seating area directly in front of it. The door is difficult to see from Classic Avenue.

entrances.name: Huron St. entrance to Sid Smith
entrances.desc: Powered doors on raised concrete patio. the patio is reachable by stairs or by a ramp under the awning to the left of the stairs.

entrances.name: North loading bay entrance to Sid Smith
entrances.desc: Powered door from the north loading bay. The slope down to the loading bays from St. George is steep; from the Huron side there is stair access only.

entrances.name: Southwest entrance to Ramsay Wright
entrances.desc: Stairs and accessible ramp lead to a powered, glass door. Entrance faces south and is visible from Huron Street when approaching from the south. Door requires a keycard to open.

entrances.name: Main accessible entrance to Warren Stevens Building
entrances.desc: A powered, glass door is approached by a level pathway. Entrance faces north and is difficult to see from Harbord Street. It is located under the concrete awning next to the large, red windows facing Harbord Street.

entrances.name: Entrance to the refectory at University College
entrances.desc: A downward sloping ramp leads to a powered door facing south. Entrance is not visible from any streets but a large sign along the pedestrian pathway to the west of University College marks the beginning of the accessible ramp.

entrances.name: Main entrance to Morrison Hall
entrances.desc: Powered entrance approachable by level path. The entrance faces west and is clearly visible from St. George street.

entrances.name: Main entrance to the University of Toronto Arts Centre
entrances.desc: Powered door under the colonnade in the UC courtyard. The door faces south, and is reached by crossing through UC, into the courtyard and under the colonnade. The wheelchair route requires using the steep road/path at th end of Tower Road.

entrances.name: Accessible entrance to Louis B. Stewart Observatory
entrances.desc: Powered door at the top of a ramp and forecourt.

entrances.name: Main entrance to Ramsey Wright
entrances.desc: Powered door accessible by ramp and stairs. Entrance is on north side of the building, facing Harbord Ave. The entrance is set back from the street, but is visible from Harbord.

entrances.name: Main accessible entrance to UC
entrances.desc: Powered door at the end of the colonnade inside the UC courtyard. The door faces west, but is reached by the steeply sloped (1:8) road/path entrance on the north side of the building. This pathway is located at the very end of Tower Road.

entrances.name: Main entrance to Grad Room cafe
entrances.desc: The pair of doors at the southeast corner of the Graduate House are level to the sidewalk. Both doors are clearly visible from the corner of Spadina Avenue and Harbord Street. The door facing south is powered.

entrances.name: Main entrance to Graduate House
entrances.desc: Stairs and an accessible ramp lead to a covered, powered door. Entrance is set back behind the concrete pillars at the top of the stairs facing Harbord Street.

entrances.name: Main entrance to the University College Union
entrances.desc: Powered door approached by a level pathway along the south side of the building. The entrance is not visible from the street, tucked behind a covered wooden porch.

entrances.name: Main entrance to Hart House
entrances.desc: Very heavy powered doors at the top of an exterior stairway. Entrance faces south and is visible from Hart House Circle. Power door mechanism operated by turning and pulling gently on the handles.

entrances.name: Main accessible entrance to Hart House
entrances.desc: Powered door at the top of a wheelchair accessible ramp. This entrance faces south, onto Tower road. It is clearly visible from the parking area. Entrance also provides accessible entry into the Justina M. Barnicke Gallery.

entrances.name: Main entrance to Early Learning Centre
entrances.desc: Stairs and an accessible ramp lead to a powered, glass door. Entrance faces north and is clearly visible from Glen Morris Street. The accessible ramp is approached from the east of the building near the parking lot.

entrances.name: East Accessible Entrance to 90 Wellesley Street
entrances.desc: A level path leads to a covered, powered door. There is a 1" bump along the path leading to the doors. Entrance faces east towards the side parking lot and is recessed into the building. It is not visible from Wellesley Street.

entrances.name: Main entrance to John P. Robarts Library
entrances.desc: Powered door at sidewalk grade level. Entrance is on East side of the building, facing St. George St. The entrance is clearly visible from St. George, on either side of the concrete spire.

entrances.name: Accessible Entrance to Muzzo Family Alumni Hall
entrances.desc: An accessible concrete ramp slopes down towards a powered door. Entrance is located at the southeast corner of the building and faces the rear parking lot. Pedestrians may approach most safely along the pathway along east side of the building.

entrances.name: South Entrance to Toronto School of Theology
entrances.desc: A wooden ramp leads to a manual covered door. Entrance faces south onto the side and rear parking lot. Doors are not powered and may require assistance to open. Accessible parking is immediately adjacent to the ramp.

entrances.name: Main entrance to the south wing of the Munk School
entrances.desc: Powered door approachable by level path under an open colonnade. The entrance is partially visible from Devonshire Ave.

entrances.name: Main entrance to Sussex Court
entrances.desc: A covered stairway leads to a manual door. The accessible entry is adjacent to it and consists of a powered door level to the sidewalk. This entry leads to an accessible lift to the main floor. Entrance faces south and is visible from Sussex Ave.

entrances.name: Main Entrance to J.M. Kelly Library
entrances.desc: A powered, glass door is approached by a small accessible curb ramp at the west end of the front plaza (near bike racks). Entrance faces north and is located under the large, concrete awning which is clearly visible from the street.

entrances.name: Main entrance to the John W. Graham Library
entrances.desc: Powered door approachable by stair and ramp. The entrance faces east into the parking lane way between Trinity College and the Munk School.

entrances.name: Main Entrance to Carr Hall
entrances.desc: A level path leads from the sidewalk to powered, glass doors. Entrance faces east and is visible from St. Joseph Street when approaching from the east.

entrances.name: Main accessible entrance for Trinity
entrances.desc: Powered door approachable by stair and ramp. The door faces west and is clearly visible from the parking lane on the west side of Trinity. The entrance is not visible from Hoskin Ave.

entrances.name: Main entrance to the north wing of the Munk School
entrances.desc: Powered door approachable by level path under an open colonnade. The entrance faces west and is partially visible from Devonshire Ave.

entrances.name: Northeast rear entrance to the Munk School
entrances.desc: A level path leads to a covered, powered door. Entrance faces east and opens onto the parking between the Munk School and Trinity College.

entrances.name: Rear entrance to Rotman School of Management
entrances.desc: A level path leads to a powered glass door. Entrance opens onto the rear laneway and is not visible from the street.

entrances.name: Main entrance to 720 Spadina Avenue
entrances.desc: A level path leads to a powered, glass door. Entrance faces east and is clearly visible from Spadina Avenue.

entrances.name: Main accessible entrance to Joseph L. Rotman School of Management
entrances.desc: A level path leads to a powered door. Entrance faces north and is located just around the side of the brick pillar of the main entrance. The door is obscured under a covered pathway but the main entrance is clearly identified by a glass awning.

entrances.name: Secondary rear entrance to Rotman School of Management
entrances.desc: A level path leads to a powered, glass door. Entrance opens onto the rear laneway and is not visible from St. George Street.

entrances.name: Main Entrance to Sam Sorbara Hall Student Residence
entrances.desc: A level path leads to a powered, glass door. Entrance faces east and is visible from St. Joseph Street when approaching from the east. Entry to building requires a keycard.

entrances.name: Secondary accessible entrance to Gerald Larkin Building
entrances.desc: Powered door approachable from the level path to the parking lot (to the north), a ramp to the south and a stairway to the east. The entrance is not visible from the street and is under the cover of a concrete colonnade.

entrances.name: Main entrance to Innis College
entrances.desc: Powered door under a building colonnade. The sidewalk level is raised up, by several stairs to the south and by a slight ramp to the north. The entrance faces east and is partially visible (under the colonnade) from St. George.

entrances.name: Main entrance to the Ignatieff Theatre
entrances.desc: Powered door approachable by stair from the west and ramp (and stair) from the east.The entrance faces west and is visible from Devonshire Ave. The route from the parking lot is the path around the building starting on the east side.

entrances.name: Main entrance to Innis College Student Residence
entrances.desc: A level path leads to a powered, glass door under a steel arch. Entrance faces west and is clearly visible from St. George Street.

entrances.name: Courtyard entrance to Innis College Student Residence
entrances.desc: A level path leads to a powered, glass door. Entrance faces east onto the exterior courtyard and is only visible from the rear laneway.

entrances.name: Secondary Entrance to Sam Sorbara Student Residence
entrances.desc: A level path leads to a powered, glass door. Entrance faces east and is not easily visible from St. Joseph Street. Entry to building requires a keycard.

entrances.name: Main entrance to the Max Gluskin House
entrances.desc: Stairs and an accessible ramp lead to a powered, glass door. The entrance faces east and is clearly visible from St. George Street.

entrances.name: Main entrance to Faculty of Law
entrances.desc: Powered door approachable by level path. The entrance faces east and is clearly visible from the Faculty of Law parking area and Queen's Park West.

entrances.name: Main Entrance to Odette Hall
entrances.desc: An accessible ramp leads to a large, powered door. Entrance faces south towards and can be seen at a distance from St. Joseph Street. Accessible parking is located immediately adjacent the entrance.

entrances.name: Main accessible entrance to Northrop Frye Hall
East Accessible Entrance to Brennan Hall
entrances.desc: A level path leads to powered, glass doors. Entrance faces east and is not visible from the street. Entrance must be approached St. Basil's Church and Odette Hall to the east as there is no accessible path leading from Brennan Hall's main entrance.

entrances.name: Main entrance to the Varsity Pavillion
entrances.desc: Powered door approachable by a low-slope covered pathway from Devonshire. The entrance faces west and is recognizable from the street by the modern colonnade leading to the doorway.

entrances.name: Main entrance to Woodsworth College
entrances.desc: A level path leads to a covered, manual door. Entrance is clearly visible from St. George Street and located under a tall concrete spire.

entrances.name: Main entrance to E.J. Pratt Library
entrances.desc: Stairs and an accessible ramp lead to a powered, glass door. Entrance faces north and is clearly visible from the main pedestrian pathay through the centre of Victoria University. However, It is not visible from any streets.

entrances.name: South Entrance to Elmsley Hall
entrances.desc: A level path and short ramp leads to a manual, double door. Entrance is located under the stone underpass between Elmsley Hall and Brennan Hall to the east. This is the only level access into the building.

entrances.name: Main entrance to Music
entrances.desc: Powered door approachable by ramp and stair. The doorway faces east and is clearly visible from the Law/Music parking area. The entrance is not visible from Queen's Park Crescent.

entrances.name: Accessible Entrance to Falconer Hall
entrances.desc: An accessible ramp leads to a powered doorway. Entrance faces south and is not visible from Avenue Road. The entrance ramp is approached along a level path from both the street and the parking lot to the south.

entrances.name: North Accessible Entrance to Brennan Hall
entrances.desc: A level path leads to a series of manual, glass doors. Entrance is approached along the paths and ramps in the sunken courtyard between Brennan Hall and Elmsley Hall.

entrances.name: Main entrance to School of Continuing Studies
entrances.desc: Stairs and an accessible ramp lead to a covered, powered door. Entrance faces east and is clearly visible from St. George Street. The accessible ramp runs through the tall grass landscaping.

entrances.name: Rear entrance to Varsity Centre
entrances.desc: Powered door approachable by level path from the parking lot. The entrance faces east over Philosopher's Walk, and is partially hidden from the parking lot. The path up from Philosopher's Walk is very steep (1:9).

entrances.name: Main accessible entrance to Victoria College
Entrance to basement classrooms at Woodsworth College Residence
entrances.desc: Stairs and a ramp lead to a covered, powered door. Entrance faces west and is visible from the street. The entrance provides access to the basement classrooms with an elevator. There is no access to the student residence. The accessible ramp serves both this entrance and the accessible entrances in the central, exterior courtyard of the b

entrances.name: Main accessible entrance to Birge-Carnegie Library
Rear entrance to Isabel Bader Theatre
Southeast entrance to Woodsworth College Residence
entrances.desc: A level path leads to a powered, glass door. Entrance faces south and is approachable from the accessible entrance along St. George Street or the path leading east towards the parking lot along Devonshire Place. Door is not visible from the street.

entrances.name: Exterior courtyard entrance to Woodsworth College Residence
entrances.desc: A level path leads to a powered, glass door. Entrance faces south onto an exterior courtyard and is approachable via the accessible ramp along St. George Street. The door is not visible from the street.

entrances.name: Main Entrance to Rotman Commerce
entrances.desc: A level path leads to a powered door. Entrance faces west and a large departmental sign marks the entrance, which is visible from St. George Street.

entrances.name: Main entrance to Isabel Bader Theatre
Main Accessible Entrance to Loretto College
entrances.desc: A level path leads to powered, covered doors. Entrance faces south directly onto the front driveway and is clearly visible from St. Mary's Street.

entrances.name: Main Entrance to Woodsworth College Residence
entrances.desc: A level path leads to a covered, powered door. Entrance faces north and is visible from Bloor street.

entrances.name: Main Accessible Entrance to Burwash Hall
entrances.desc: An accesible ramp leads to a manual wooden door. Door is unlocked and opened from the inside. Entrance faces north and is clearly visible from Charles Street.

entrances.name: North Entrance to Burwash Residences (Upper Houses)
entrances.desc: A level path leads to a manual, wooden door. Entrance faces north and is clearly visible from Charles Street. Building is accessed via keycard only.

entrances.name: Main Entrance to Rowell Jackman Hall
entrances.desc: A level path leads to a powered, glass door. Entrance faces north and is clearly visible from Charles Street. Keycard access is required to enter the building.

entrances.name: Main Entrance to Jackman Humanities Building
entrances.desc: A level path leads to an automatic sliding door. Entrance faces east and is clearly visible from St. George Street.

entrances.name: Main entrance to 246 Bloor Street
entrances.desc: A level path leads directly from the powered door to the Bloor Street sidewalk. The entrance faces south and located under a covered recess in the facade of the building.

entrances.name: Main Entrance to Margaret Addison Hall
entrances.desc: A sidewalk and temporary ramp lead to a manual, glass door. Assistance may be required to open doors. Entrance faces west onto the vehicle drop-off zone but is not clearly visible from Charles Street.

entrances.name: Main entrance to Lillian Massey Building
Main accessible entrance to OISE(UofT)
entrances.desc: A glass revolving doorway and an adjacent accessible entrance with a powered door faces west. Follow the colonnade along the west wall which can be accessed via the stairs and accessible ramp along Bloor Street. Door not visible from the street.

entrances.name: Rear accessible entrance to 246 Bloor Street West
entrances.desc: A powered door is approached by a level surface leading to the parking lot located at the rear of the Social Work building. It is also approachable through the parkette along Bloor Street to the south. The entrance is not visible from the street.

entrances.name: East entrance to OISE
entrances.desc: A manual door opens onto a covered colonnade. It is approchable by a metal staircase leading to the parking lot to the east or the pathway and ramp at the front of the building to the south. The entrance faces east and is not visible from the street.

entrances.name: Second Entrance to OISE(UofT)
entrances.desc: Level path leads to a manual glass door. Entrance faces south and is located under a long colonnade. Approachable from the south via stairs and accessible ramp along Bloor street.

entrances.name: Accessible entrance to 455 Spadina
entrances.desc: The entrance to 455 Spadina Ave. has powered doors, and is located at the mid-point of the building off Spadina Ave. An elevator is required to access the Accessibility Office, which is located on the 4th floor.

entrances.name: Main entrance to Myhal Centre
entrances.desc: Three entrances are located at the northwest, northeast, and south side of the building with power door operator.

entrances.name: Main entrance to Galbraith Building
entrances.desc: Powered door operator located at top of gentle sloped landscape. The power door operator is located to the right of the entrance. A stair lift is located inside on the right stairwell.

entrances.name: Rear entrance to Tower Room of University College
entrances.desc: A level sidewalk path leads to a powered door operator. Entrance is located at the rear of the circular tower and is not visible from King's College Circle. Entry is wheelchair accessible but only opened from the inside for specific events.

entrances.name: Southwest entrance to University College
entrances.desc: A covered path leads to a powered door operator. The entrance faces south and is largely obscured by colonnade which shelters the path leading towards the door. Look for the archway east of the adjacent circular tower.

entrances.name: Southwest courtyard entrance to University College
entrances.desc: Powered door operator visible from the courtyard. Entrance faces north and is located inside the archway connecting the University College courtyard and the pedestrian pathway that connects King's College Circle and Hoskin Avenue.

entrances.name: Accessible Entrance to The Arbor Room at Hart House
entrances.desc: A powered door is located at the bottom of a ramp along the south side of Hart House. The entrance faces south and is visible in the corner of the outdoor patio.

entrances.name: East Entrance to Medical Sciences Building
entrances.desc: A powered door operator is located at the top of the sloped Welcome Path.

entrances.name: Main entrance to Robarts Common
entrances.desc: Powered door at south end of building at sidewalk grade level into Robarts Common.

entrances.name: West Entrance to the Mining Building
entrances.desc: A ramp behind the bicycle rings leads to a powered door operator and elevator into the Lassonde Mining Building. The entrances faces west to King's College Road.

entrances.name: Accessible entrance to the Student Commons
entrances.desc: Powered door approached by level sidewalk. The door faces east and is located in the lane east of the building.

entrances.name: Main entrance to the Faculty of Law Building
entrances.desc: A winding sloped pathway up from Philosopher's Walk leads to the entrance. Entrance faces south and is located in a courtyard at the end of the path.

entrances.name: Secondary entrance to Faculty of Law
entrances.desc: Powered entrance approachable via a short ramp up to a raised walkway. The courtyard is not visible from the street. The access to this area from Philosopher's Walk requires going up many steps. An accessible route to this entrance is possible from the parking area off of Queen's Park West.

entrances.name: Main entrance to Flavelle House
entrances.desc: Powered door approachable by level path. The entrance faces north and is clearly visible from the Faculty of Law parking area and Queen's Park West.

entrances.name: Rear entrance to the Goldring Centre for High Performance Sport
entrances.desc: Powered door approached via pathway between Woodsworth and Goldring Centre. The pathway can be accessed from St. George Street.

entrances.name: Main entrance to the Goldring Centre for High Performance Sport
entrances.desc: Powered door approached from Devonshire Place.

entrances.name: East entrance to the Daniels Building
entrances.desc: A gently sloped path leads to the east entrance. An accessible layby and parking is located west of the building. The entrance is visible from the crosswalk at Ursula Franklin Street.

entrances.name: West entrance to the Daniels Building
entrances.desc: A gently sloped path leads to the west entrance. An accessible layby and parking is located west of the building.

entrances.name: Devonshire entrance to 315 Bloor Street West
entrances.desc: A ramp leads to an accessible entrance from Devonshire Place.

entrances.name: Accessible entrance to Knox College
entrances.desc: An accessible entrance is located at the north end of the building from the Knox College Parking Lot. The entrance provides accessibility to the east wing of Knox College only.

entrances.name: Main entrance to Gage Building
entrances.desc: Manual door approached by stair only. This entrance faces east into the Gage parking lot, and is visible from College St. when travelling west.

entrances.name: Main entrance to 254/256 McCaul Street
entrances.desc: Two steps lead to a covered, manual door. Entrance faces East and is clearly visible from McCaul Street.

entrances.name: Main entrance to the Campus Bookstore
entrances.desc: This door at the south-west corner of Koffler leads directly into the Campus Bookstore. The entrance is at grade but does not have a power opener. The bookstore can be used as a cross-through into the rest of the Koffler building.

entrances.name: Main entrance to the Koffler Student Services Centre
entrances.desc: Manual door approached by a substantial outdoor stair. The entrance faces south and is clearly visible from College street.

entrances.name: Courtyard entrance to the Field's Institute
entrances.desc: Manual entrance approachable by stair only, via the rear patio. This entrance faces south and is only visible from within the pedestrian courtyard.

entrances.name: Main entrance to Wallberg Memorial Building (west)
entrances.desc: Wallberg Memorial Building has 2 main entrances facing College street. Each has manual doors approached by a large stair, clearly visible from the street.

entrances.name: Rear entrance to the Wallberg Memorial Building (west)
entrances.desc: Stairs lead down to a manual door and interior stairwell. Entrance faces north onto the rear parking lot of the Wallburg Memorial Building and is not visible from the street.

entrances.name: Main entrance to Wallberg Memorial Building (east)
entrances.desc: Wallberg Memorial Building has 2 main entrances facing College street. Each has manual doors approached by a large stair, clearly visible from the street.

entrances.name: East entrance to the Wallberg Memorial Building
entrances.desc: A single step leads to a manual doorway. Entry faces east and is clearly visible from King's College Road.

entrances.name: Main entrance to Stewart Building
entrances.desc: Large stair leads to a covered manual door. Entrance faces North and is located under the large, double arch atop the brick stair case.

entrances.name: South Entrance to the Daniels Building
entrances.desc: A gently sloped path leads to the entrance and Belvedere at the south end of the building. This entrance does not have a power door operator. Entrances with power door operators are located at the west and east ends of the building. An accessible layby and parking is located at the west of the building.

entrances.name: Main entrance to the mining building
entrances.desc: Manual door approached by a large stair. This entrance faces south and is clearly visible from College St.

entrances.name: Rear entrance to the Wallberg Memorial Building (east)
entrances.desc: Stair leads up to a manual door. Entry faces west onto the rear parking lot of the Wallberg Memorial Building and is not visible from the street. Entry also provides access to the D.L. Pratt Building.

entrances.name: Courtyard entrance to the D.L. Pratt Building
entrances.desc: Single step leads to a manual door. Entrance faces east and is partially visible from King's College Road when walking north. Entrance serves the parking lot immediately adjacent.

entrances.name: Rear entrance to the Cumberland House
entrances.desc: Stair leads to a manual door. Entrance faces east and is not visible from the street. Level approach is from the pathway on the north side of Cumberland House.

entrances.name: East entry to the Mining Building
entrances.desc: A long, angled stairway leads to a manual door. Entrance faces east and is obscured behind trees when viewed from College Street. Guard rails around stairs block all but the northerly approach.

entrances.name: Secondary entrance to Mining
entrances.desc: Manual door approached by a small stair. This entrance faces north and is only visible from the service/pedestrian alley of the mining/engineering annex.

entrances.name: Designated accessible entrance to the Engineering Annex
entrances.desc: The ramp designates the north entrance as the most accessible, however the door does not have a power opener. The ramp is short and steep and faces the pedestrian alley between the Pratt and Sanford Fleming buildings.

entrances.name: Main entrance to the Eng. Annex
entrances.desc: Antique manual door approached by 3 steps from the pedestrian alley between the Pratt and Sanford Fleming buildings.

entrances.name: Main entrance to the Pratt Building
entrances.desc: Manual door approached by a level path. The entrance faces north and is only partially visible from King's College road.

entrances.name: Southwest Entrance to the Sanford Fleming Building
entrances.desc: Short stair leads to a manual door. Entrance faces south and can be approached from St. George Street or King's College Road via the passage that runs along the south wall of the Sanford Fleming Building. Entrance also serves the Galbraith Building.

entrances.name: Main entrance to the Haultain Building
entrances.desc: Manual door approached by stair. The entrance faces and is visible only from the service/pedestrian route through the engineering annex.

entrances.name: Main entrance to the Rosebrugh Building
entrances.desc: Manual door approached by level sidewalk. The entrance faces east, sharing the wide modern pedestrian concourse that leads to to the Donnelly building. It is partially visible from the street.

entrances.name: South Entrance to the Sanford Fleming Building
entrances.desc: Short stair leading to a manual door. Entrance faces south and is not visible from King's College Rd. Approached along pathway between the Sanford Fleming and D.L. Pratt buildings which can be obstructed by locked bicycles.

entrances.name: Second north entrance to Bahen Centre for Information Technology
entrances.desc: A level path leads to a manual, glass door. Entrance is hidden in the corner of a small courtyard opposite the brick house and behind the bicycle parking racks.

entrances.name: Secondary entrance to Anthropology
entrances.desc: Manual door at the top of 5 stairs. Clearly visible from Ursula Franklin street.

entrances.name: South main entrance to Sanford Fleming
entrances.desc: Manual doorway approachable by stair from King's College road. The entrance faces west and is clearly visible from the street.

entrances.name: Secondary entrance to the Pharmacy Building
entrances.desc: Manual door approached by level path. This entrance faces north and is not visible from the street.

entrances.name: Northwest entrance to the Galbraith Building
entrances.desc: Level pathway leads to a manual door. Entrance faces north and is clearly visible from St. George Street. Entrance is located immediately adjacent to the building service entry.

entrances.name: Main entrance to Borden Building South
entrances.desc: Stairs lead to a covered, manual door. Entrance faces west and is clearly visible from Spadina Avenue. Located just beside the driveway entrance under the bridge that connect to Borden Building North.

entrances.name: Entrance to the Victorian House at the Bahen Centre

entrances.desc: Three steps leading to a manual, glass door located under a covered porch. Door faces east and is visible from St. George Street. An accessible lift is located at the rear of the building. Please contact building staff ahead of arrival for assistance.

entrances.name: South Entrance to Burwash Hall (Upper Houses)
entrances.desc: Two steps lead to a covered, wooded door. Entrance is located under a large stone archway and is not visible from the end of St. Mary's Street.

entrances.name: Southwest Entrance to Burwash Hall (Upper Residences)
entrances.desc: Three steps lead to a covered, manual door. Entrance faces west onto the Victoria College courtyard and is not visible from St. Mary's Street. Entry to building requires a keycard.

entrances.name: Northwest entrance to Varsity Arena
entrances.desc: The manual door is approached along a level pathway running under the stadium seating of the Varsity Centre. Primary access to this pathway is through the Varsity Centre entrance to the south which is visible from Devonshire Place.

entrances.name: South Entrance to Rowell Jackmann Hall
entrances.desc: A level path leads to a manual, double door. Entrance faces south and is clearly visible from the end of St. Mary's Street. Keycard access is required to enter the building.

entrances.name: West Entrance to Burwash Hall (Upper Houses)
entrances.desc: Three steps lead to a covered, manual door. Entrance faces west onto the Victoria College courtyard and is not visible from St. Mary's Street. Entry to building requires a keycard.

entrances.name: Main entrance to Loretto College
entrances.desc: A pair of stairs leads up to covered, manual doors. Entrance faces south and is partially obscured from sight by landscaping along St. Mary's Street.

entrances.name: Rear entrance to Burwash Hall
entrances.desc: Five steps lead to a covered, manual door. Entrance faces south towards the rear plaza and is not visible from Charles Street.

entrances.name: Entrance to Burwash Hall Guest House
entrances.desc: A single step leads to a covered, manual door. Entrance is located under a covered archway which is clearly visible from the street.

entrances.name: Northwest entrance to Burwash Hall (Upper Houses)
entrances.desc: Three steps leads to a covered, manual door. Entrance faces west onto the Victoria College Courtyard and is not visible from Charles Street. Entry to building requires a keycard.

entrances.name: Main entrance to 315 Bloor Street West
entrances.desc: Stairs lead to a manual, double door. Entrance faces north and is clearly visible from Bloor Street West.

entrances.name: West Entrance to Rowell Jackman Hall
entrances.desc: A level path leads to a manual glass door. Entrance faces west and opens onto the pedestrian pathway leading to Charles Street and St. Mary's Street. Keycard access is required to access the building.

entrances.name: Main entrance to Burwash Hall
entrances.desc: Three steps leads to manual wooden doors. Entrance faces north and is clearly visible from Charles Street.

entrances.name: South Entrance to Annesley Hall
entrances.desc: Stairs lead up to a manual, double door. Entrance faces west and is opens onto the landing atop the large stairs. Entrance is not visible from Charles Street.

entrances.name: West entrance to Jackman Humanities Building
entrances.desc: A level path leads to a manual door. Entrance faces west and is not visible from the street. Approach from Bloor Street along the laneway to the west of the building.

entrances.name: Second entrance to Margaret Addison Hall
entrances.desc: A single step leads to a manual, glass door. Entrance faces west and is difficult to see from Charles Street.

entrances.name: West entrance to the Wallberg Memorial Building
entrances.desc: Step leads to a manual doorway. Entry faces west and is clearly visible from St. George Street.
